title: Unit 3 consolidation: the arrival of the Europeans
goal: I can tell the story of 1492 and its consequences in the Caribbean.
grammar: Review: cuando and mientras, contrast connectors, a pesar de, causes, doubt

items: Tell the story of 1492 and its consequences in the Caribbean.
Say what was going on while something happened, using cuando and mientras.
Contrast two ideas with sin embargo and no obstante, and use a pesar de.
Give the causes of a change in history.
Express doubt and possibility about the past with the subjunctive.
